data.action: 极速滑铲突进甩出青蓝单分子线切裂敌机，火花在暴雨中炸裂，眼神凌厉绝杀
data.camera: dynamic low angle, action freeze frame
data.description: 【露西 · 赛博暗巷的单分子线截杀】倾盆大雨冲刷的昏暗潮湿小巷中，雨水在垃圾桶与废弃电缆间飞溅。露西极速向前滑铲突进，右手手腕的线轴中骤然爆射出数道极细耀眼的青蓝单分子光丝。锋利光丝撕裂雨幕将眼前的无人机瞬间切碎，火花在雨夜中剧烈四溅，清冷神情带着不可阻挡的决绝死意。
data.lighting: 单分子线青蓝电弧闪光与火花照亮潮湿积水路面
data.location: 大雨滂沱的狭窄赛博暗巷废墟
data.promptProse: Lucy slides forward through a rain-soaked alley, firing thin cyan monowires from the spool on her right wrist to slice the attacking drone into sparking pieces. Her netrunner jacket and technical bodysuit retain their silhouette in the dynamic low view. Bins and abandoned cables layer behind the action. Wire arcs light her focused face and glove, while sparks reflect across puddles and reveal rain between the broken drone fragments.
data.title: 露西 · 赛博暗巷的单分子线截杀
